MESSAGE:
Subject: Dispute of Duplicate Invoice – INV-2609-07 (September 2026 Hosting)

Dear Acme Cloud Services Team,

We are writing regarding two invoices received for September 2026 hosting services under our contract (term: 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026):

- INV-2609-01: September 2026 service period, Rs 2,00,000, paid on 5 September 2026
- INV-2609-07: September 2026 service period, Rs 2,00,000, status pending, due 30 September 2026

Both invoices cover the identical service period and amount. Our contract specifies one invoice per month at a monthly fee of Rs 2,00,000 (12 months = Rs 24,00,000 annually). As INV-2609-01 has already been paid in full for September 2026, INV-2609-07 appears to be a duplicate that should not have been issued.

We request that you:
1. Confirm that INV-2609-07 is indeed a duplicate of INV-2609-01;
2. Cancel INV-2609-07 in your billing system; and
3. Provide written confirmation of this cancellation for our records.

If any payment has already been processed against INV-2609-07, please issue a credit note for Rs 2,00,000 at your earliest convenience.

We value our ongoing partnership and appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. Please let us know if you require any further information from our side to process this correction.

Kind regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement
